data: The build process was compiling the 'core' component of a C++ project using CMake. The build failed because `socket.cpp` referenced an undeclared function named `connect_timeout`, causing a compilation error.
A C++ project was being compiled using CMake to build the core object files. The build failed because the code in `src/socket.cpp` referenced an undeclared function named `connect_timeout`.

A C++ project component named core was being built using CMake. The build failed because the compilation of `socket.cpp` encountered an error where the function `connect_timeout` was not declared in the scope.
